_about: The High Tower of Magic (levels 7-25): masters who fight with spell and summoning, mages and teachers who come to each other's alarm, guardians that wake together, the Mad Alchemist a sub-boss, and the Master Summoner in his Pentagram Chamber, tearing glyphs into the floor and calling demons through.
